traditional: 對 A 有負面影響
jyutping: deoi3 A jau5 fu6 min2 jing2 hoeng2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction when something negatively affects a person, thing, or outcome.

examples.english: This report negatively affects the company.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告對公司有負面影響。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 gung1 si1 jau5 fu6 min2 jing2 hoeng2
